name: RED Atlas API
description: RED Atlas gives your AI assistant direct, authenticated access to RED Atlas real-estate data for Puerto Rico and Colombia. Search and retrieve listings, parcels, properties, transactions, permits, taxes and market news; run market statistics and analytics (rankings, cross-tabs, trends and one-call market reports); look up locations and boundary polygons; generate AVM and comparables valuation reports; and pull parcel owner/contact enrichment. Ask in natural language and get answers grounded in Atlas data, with canonical links back to the RED Atlas app. Access uses the user's own RED Atlas account and is billed to their plan.

_published_faq.name: How do I add RED Atlas API to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add RED Atlas API to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://apiv3.atlas.red/external-api/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the RED Atlas API MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: RED Atlas API lists 16 MCP tools, including atlas_create_avm_report, atlas_create_comparables_report, atlas_get_parcel_contacts, atlas_get_record, atlas_get_report, atlas_get_stats, atlas_list_entities, atlas_list_reports, atlas_lookup_location, atlas_market_report, atlas_pivot, and atlas_query_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to RED Atlas API?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to RED Atlas API in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does RED Atlas API MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: RED Atlas API requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
RED Atlas API is developed by RED Atlas. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
